title: Fracking and Geothermal Energy: An Unconventional Alliance
content: The controversial practice of hydrofracking used in fossil fuel extraction might hold the key to a renewable energy future. As global demand for electricity increases and governments focus on decarbonized, dispatchable energy sources, geothermal systems are ready for a breakthrough. Transformative Enhanced Geothermal Systems (EGS) use hydraulic fracturing to access heat from hot, dry rock deep beneath the Earth's surface. Fracking for geothermal energy has moved from theory a few years ago to reality today.
author: Rae Michos
